title: Getting angry fries $50 million of computers at the Augsburg field station
place_text: Augsburg, Germany (and East German Soviet computers)

tellings.quote: When I did, the entire field station went down.

plain: Lyn Buchanan, an Army sergeant, says that in the 1980s, at the Army's field station in Augsburg, Germany, he got angry and the computers went down, about $50 million worth of them; the story also reaches to Soviet computers in East Germany. He tells Michels it happened to him: "When I did, the entire field station went down." If true, it would mean a person's mind or emotions could knock out machines.
